title: 2BR Private Escape 30min to Nashville With Kitchen
description:
A quiet 2-bedroom ground-floor retreat in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee — 30 minutes from downtown Nashville. Full kitchen, private back deck, year-round stream, and cozy fireplace. Keyless entry, washer/dryer, organic mattresses. Perfect for couples, small families, extended stays, and remote workers who want nature close and Nashville closer.

*Exterior motion camera in use. This is the lower unit of a vertical duplex — no shared interior spaces.

The space
✓Large, fully equipped kitchen with all cooking necessities for your convenience.
✓Stainless dishwasher, microwave, oven, and refrigerator for easy meal preparation.
✓Dining room, perfect for planning your exciting adventures.
✓Comfortable living room with a reclining couch, Roku, and TV (BYOL - Bring Your Own Login).
✓Master bedroom features a luxurious 12" king organic memory foam mattress for a restful sleep.
✓Guest bedroom offers a cozy queen memory foam mattress for a great night's rest.
✓Relax and unwind on the back deck, an ideal spot for breakfast, enjoying a good book, or conducting business.
✓Convenient washer and dryer with detergent provided.
✓Private driveway for your exclusive use.
✓Enjoy the serene ambiance of a small year-round stream flowing through the backyard, complete with a swing.
✓If you require parking for a boat or trailer, please let us know in advance to make arrangements.
✓Take advantage of our kayaks for rent (subject to availability). Message us to express your interest. $60/kayak per day.
✓Access is easy and secure with a touch-code keypad. Rest assured, codes are changed for every guest for heightened security.
✓Book now to secure this beautiful slice of Music City and enjoy all it has to offer.

Guest access
Full downstairs (no shared interior spaces) this is a vertical duplex.
Back yard half.
Front yard half.
Private Lower deck
In unit Washer and dryer
Private driveway

Other things to note
This unit is below another. There are NO spaces shared between them. It is possible to hear footsteps.
